overstatement_check: SERIOUS wrong-model attribution in the second clause: 'independent academic review of DeepMind's safety case found it provides only weak confirmation that this risk is adequately managed'. The cited paper (arXiv:2604.21964, 'Lessons from External Review of DeepMind's Scheming Inability Safety Case', submitted 2026-04-23) reviews the GEMINI 2.5 PRO scheming inability safety case (Phuong et al., 2025) — the string 'Gemini 3' appears zero times in it. The same inability argument underpins the Gemini 3 FSF determination, but the Finding as written misattributes the review.
